description: This file defines a wizard for tracking and splitting stock moves in an Odoo (OpenERP) manufacturing module, including form definitions, validation, and move line creation logic.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: A wizard interface for tracking and splitting stock moves, with defined states for user interaction.

methods.name: _check_picking
methods.description: Validates that the stock move has an associated picking or production order before splitting.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Creates new stock move lines with tracking prefixes, updates quantities, and links production orders.
